name: Mizuki
source:
Her full name is Mizuki Hayakawa, and she's one half of the rogue duo known as Chrontek. Their goal seems to be to somehow manipulate the flow of time to suit their own purposes... and they're causing no small amount of trouble for the Time Tenshi in the process!

Mizuki's from Japan with an ancestry steeped in the ways of the ninja. She has long, purple hair but prefers to keep it tied in a braided ponytail with a cute matching bow. Her skill with her katana is nothing short of legendary, and her personality tends to be reserved, bordering on downright moody at times. But like a beautiful koi carp swimming in a moonlit pond, some say she has a soft heart beneath her mysterious surface...

She enjoys taking a dip in relaxing hot springs in her downtime from ninja training, and her favorite food is sushi. In-game she has two outfits: her Time Suit, which you can see her, as well as a more casual outfit for more relaxed occasions.

"What you fail to see is that the safe path isn't always the correct one. That we must take risks and push science to its limit in order to do the greatest good."

-From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/silvercow/time-tenshi-time-travelling-anime-visual-novel/posts/2742253]Time Tenshi Kickstarter update #6[/url]
